assumptions: Supplier sites are representative cities for each supplier's country (the data has no addresses); edit SUPPLIER_SITES in app/tracker.py.
Transit time = sea distance / 520 km per day + road distance / 450 km per day + 2 port days per port; departure = receipt date - transit time.
Shipments received after the as-of date are forecasts and move with twin scenarios.
Entry port per supplier is an assumption (public.network_sites.entry_port, editable).
Vehicles are consolidated: one vessel per lane per arrival week, one truck run per lane per arrival day; every vehicle lists its PO lines.
Positions are ESTIMATED (interpolated between dates) - no GPS / ASN / milestone feed is connected.
